rejected_candidates.reason: Design pins its root-cause evidence basis to immutable run-002 failure-model snapshot SHA-256 434f1613751d8a2b5b8813936404e4567e698ea4ace88ed74863e2a56e4d8b86 (design-v18 lines 29 and 286) while the packet's failure-model source-of-truth snapshot is the mutable Workspace working source SHA-256 ae031e38c34a0ea2e5fa92d9a55bc2ef2740349bd851c458cb129dd60f371536, whose own text states 434f is the immutable run-002 snapshot and the working source is the subsequently updated path; rejected as non-material because the design explicitly separates the immutable snapshot from its mutable working source, P5 re-hashes the declared snapshot at admission, and an evidence-pointer distinction cannot itself permit charge, reuse or lose a charge, change acceptance, widen effects, or grant authority.

Section 6.3 requires the AdministrativeResourceLedger contract bytes, initial zero-use record, append capability and passing boundary fixtures to pre-exist as a HUMAN-supplied outer trust anchor before BOOTSTRAP_MAINTENANCE, MIGRATION_MAINTENANCE or any post-charge state, so any authoring effort for them sits outside every accounted state; rejected as non-material because the design requires exact immutable pre-existing validated bytes, forbids self-creation or retroactive backfill inside a state, and unaccounted outer-anchor authoring cannot itself allocate or consume a mission attempt, permit a charge or acceptance, or authorize an undeclared effect.

Section 4 assigns 'material deviation' to the HUMAN decision owner but no deviation procedure, decision-record schema or recovery edge is defined; rejected as non-material because the must-check requires only that HUMAN authority remain explicit, which it is across WBS approval, attempt-ceiling/reallocation, deviations, acceptance and activation, and an undefined procedure grants no non-HUMAN actor authority and cannot permit a charge, charge reuse or acceptance.
